srd.name: White Dragon Wyrmling
srd.Speed: 30 ft., burrow 15 ft., fly 60 ft., swim 30 ft.
srd.Senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft.,  Passive Perception 14
srd.Actions:
Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage.

Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6). The dragon exhales an icy blast of hail in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (5d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
